name: Nashua Summer Camps
operator_name: City of Nashua Parks and Recreation
description_short: The City of Nashua Parks and Recreation runs a range of full-day and half-day summer camps, mostly Monday to Friday. Camps include sports, music, art, STEAM and swim lessons. Some are run by city staff and some by partner organizations.
refund_policy_summary: You get a check refund if you cancel at least 14 days before the program starts, or if you send documentation such as a doctor's note saying the child can't take part. Cancelling 7 to 13 days before the start gets a household credit only. Cancelling 6 days or fewer before the start gets no refund. Camps run by outside organizations may have different refund policies.

warnings: This is an overview page for many separate city-run and partner-run camps, not a single camp. Each camp has its own dates, times, locations, ages and prices, listed on nashua.recdesk.com.
The 2027 season is not yet posted. The linked registration and swim-lesson forms are the 2026 versions.
Partner camps (Nashua Community Music School, New England School of Archery, Skyhawks Sports, Wicked Cool for Kids) are run by outside organizations and may have different refund policies.
camp_type is set to 'day' because the page says there are full-day and half-day options. It does not say outright that no camps are overnight.
